name: bytebank
description: Bytebank — monorepo de microfrontends (chassi + MFEs) da Fase 2

scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @bytebank/mfe-events && npm run build -w @bytebank/core
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shell,dashboard,transacoes -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm:dev:shell" "npm:dev:dashboard" "npm:dev:transacoes"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w dashboard && npm run build -w transacoes && npm run build -w shell
